# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-eight in Volume 1, around thirty-three by Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c16 P63](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0063), [v4 c10 P48](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c16 P58](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0058)</sub>
- **Status:** Married to Adrian Treleaven  <sub>[v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v4 c5 P6](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; lodging host  <sub>[v2 c11 P22](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0022), [v2 c11 P28](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Rufus Vane  <sub>[v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042)</sub>; Mrs. Adrian Treleaven  <sub>[v4 c39 P0](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is a tall, exquisitely beautiful woman with cream-white skin, blue eyes, and striking golden-wheat hair that reaches down to her feet when unbound. She frequently wears simple dresses accented with a splash of crimson, such as a red sash or a blood-red rose.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v2 c11 P30](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0030), [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c10 P5](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0005)_

## Personality

Intense, proud, and fiercely loyal to her loved ones, Lorna possesses a deep capacity for affection and passion despite years of tragic isolation. Initially guarded and prone to harboring bitter envy toward those enjoying happier lives, she blossoms into a joyful and warm companion once she opens her heart. She harbors an intense love for nature, the sea, and music, while maintaining a proud independence.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P28](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0028), [v2 c11 P36](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0036), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v4 c12 P11](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0011), [v4 c21 P3](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0003), [v4 c21 P11](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0011)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls, enduring the traumatic childhood losses of her brother Julian and her father Frank. To prevent her widowed mother from losing their farm, she sacrificed her academic ambitions and married Rufus Vane. Following Rufus's departure on a voyage, a brain-injured man believed to be Rufus returned, whom Lorna faithfully cared for over eleven years at the Ainslie farm. After meeting Nell Harcourt, Lorna slowly opened her heart to friendship, though she struggled with secret envy over Nell's happiness. When writer Adrian Treleaven stayed as a boarder at her house, the two fell deeply in love, though Lorna concealed her feelings due to her marital bond. Dr. Hugh Carrow eventually realized that the man in Lorna's care might be cured by surgery; upon undergoing the operation in Montreal, the man recovered his memory and revealed that he was actually Rufus's cousin, Laurence Vane, and that the real Rufus had died years prior in Cuba. Suddenly freed from her tragic burden, Lorna accepted Adrian Treleaven's proposal, married him in the garden of Echo Cottage, and moved with him to Boston.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v2 c11 P34](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0034), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c29 P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 c30 P10](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0010), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015), [v4 c36 P23](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0023), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 c38 P34](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0034)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr of Seven Gulls  <sub>[v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Witnessed the tragic death of her younger brother Julian as a child  <sub>[v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016), [v2 c11 P17](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0017)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after he committed suicide by hanging  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Forced into an unwanted marriage with Rufus Vane to save her mother from eviction  <sub>[v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Spent eleven years caring for a man she believed was her brain-damaged husband, who was actually his cousin Laurence Vane  <sub>[v2 c11 P34](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0034), [v2 c11 P36](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0036), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015)</sub>
